unlisted_practices: Iterative expert-guided annotation loop with model-generated presegmentations corrected by radiologists to create reference standard segmentations
Active learning-based versus random sample selection for training data annotation
No-code implementation of the annotation loop in a clinical environment
Estimating expert time and cost savings of AI-assisted annotation

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the impact of an active learning human-in-the-loop annotation strategy versus standard manual annotation on clinician time and operational costs across multiple clinical datasets.
